parameters.query:
=-- Search for: {{ $json.cleanQuery }}
-- Practice: {{ $json.practiceId }}

SELECT DISTINCT
  p.id,
  p.first_name,
  p.last_name,
  p.date_of_birth,
  p.gender,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(p.date_of_birth)) as age
FROM patients p
WHERE p.practice_id = '{{ $json.practiceId }}'
  AND p.gender = 'female'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(p.date_of_birth)) > 50
  AND p.active = true
LIMIT 100;
